Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production VFX texture atlas for Adventurer: Expeditions, a painted high-detail anime action RPG. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, sixteen equally sized square cells on a 2048 by 2048 canvas. NO grid lines, NO labels or numbers, NO UI frames, NO text. All cells share equal invisible 512-pixel squares. Each effect fully contained in its own square with 12% empty margin, no art crosses cell boundaries. GENUINE transparent RGBA background, including between particles and the hollow centers of aura rings; no checkerboard or black panel baked in. Isolated effects only, no people, weapons, terrain, or scene. Painted luminous textures with crisp cel-shaped cores and finely feathered transparent particles, matching rich polished Adventurer fantasy artwork rather than simple vector symbols. Readable at small scale, carefully separated silhouettes. Row-major exact contents:
Row1 col1: narrow violet-white katana crescent sweep, opening to right, directional trailing taper. Col2: two intersecting violet-white katana sweeps forming a diagonal X, same thickness. Col3: broad powerful violet-white fan sweep with three layered edge ribbons and few gold sparks. Col4: three translucent violet human-shaped motion echoes without facial detail, fading from right to left, for Hiro afterimage, no solid person.
Row2 col1: thin violet elliptical ground aura ring, slight low side-view perspective, hollow center. Col2: same ring with two rotating-looking concentric ribbons, modest scattered motes. Col3: same ring at maximum power with three concentric violet/gold bands and upward energy tongues, hollow center. Col4: isolated orange-gold fire projectile moving right, pointed hot white core and orange flame tail to left.
Row3 col1: isolated icy cyan shard projectile moving right, crystalline pointed core and soft frost tail to left. Col2: isolated electric blue jagged lightning bolt moving right with a branching bright white core. Col3: non-graphic Bleed status badge: three diagonal ruby-red slash marks and one abstract red droplet, no body or wound. Col4: Poison status badge: vivid emerald droplet enclosing tiny curved fang shape with two violet bubbles, no skull.
Row4 col1: low lateral beige dust puff from a foot skid, readable layered wisps. Col2: crisp tiny gold-white impact starburst with 8 asymmetrical sparks. Col3: vertical stylized defeat light: warm gold and violet translucent motes rising and dispersing, luminous wisps, no corpse. Col4: white-blue shield impact ripple: broken concentric semicircles with sparse sparks, transparent center.
Every one of the sixteen subjects centered in its assigned square, separated generous alpha padding. No gore, blood splatter, brands, watermark. This is an original hand-painted runtime texture SOURCE atlas, not a screenshot or sample page.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game skill-icon atlas for Adventurer: Expeditions. Exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, eight equal square cells on a 2048x1024 canvas. No labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, grid lines, UI border rings or backing plates. Each icon has transparent background and 12% empty margin inside its own 512x512 cell; no crossing boundaries. These icons belong to Bram, an adult sword-and-shield fantasy hero. Match detailed polished anime-cel-painted RPG artwork, metallic edge highlights, rich restrained navy, steel, warm gold, russet color scheme. Strong large focal symbols readable at 64px. Make each meaning distinct; not eight variations of one shield. Exact row-major arrangement:
Row1 col1 Shield Wall active: three steel shields overlapping as a defensive barrier with pale blue energy seam.
Row1 col2 Cleave active: broad steel sword sweeping through a bright gold crescent, no victim.
Row1 col3 Bulwark perk: solid stone tower bastion behind a single small steel shield, glowing protective core.
Row1 col4 Taunt active: armored gauntlet beckoning with two fingers toward the viewer with outward orange attention rays; no face.
Row2 col1 Sunder active: sword point striking and cracking a discarded metal chestplate, clean sparks, no person or blood.
Row2 col2 Stand Fast active: one armored boot firmly planted on rock beneath an ascending golden ward, symbol of rising again.
Row2 col3 Momentum perk: heavy steel fist moving right with three accelerating golden motion trails.
Row2 col4 Arena Champion perk: gold laurel wreath embracing upright short sword and a small restored-heart ruby at its base, victory and recovery without text.
Consistent painted depth and lighting. No comic outline circles, no emblems from existing franchises. The surrounding canvas and all gaps must be genuinely transparent RGBA, no colored background or checkerboard.

hiro:
Use case: stylized-concept. A painted premium anime RPG skill-icon and tier-ring SOURCE sheet for Adventurer: Expeditions. Exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, nine equal square cells on square 1536x1536 canvas. Transparent RGBA everywhere outside the subjects. No text, numbers, letters, labels, watermark, grid lines, backing plates or title. The first six cells are icons for Hiro the dark-skinned cyberpunk samurai with purple locs; use no portrait or face, convey his violet/graphite/silver/gold palette in weapons and symbols. Match refined painted metal, convincing depth, clean cel-shaped highlights. Keep each subject centered and fully visible in the inner 70% of its cell. No crossing or shared glows. Row-major exact contents:
Row1 col1 katana_slash: single polished silver katana with purple grip in a narrow luminous violet crescent, blade diagonal lower-left to upper-right.
Row1 col2 god_aura: three elevated purple-gold concentric protective orbit rings with rising violet motes, symbol of attack defense and evasion; no religious icon or person.
Row1 col3 counter_attack: silver katana meeting an oncoming dark blade at a brilliant gold parry spark, distinct crossed narrow blades.
Row2 col1 finisher: dramatically descending silver katana ending in a sharp star-shaped violet-gold impact bloom, no target or blood.
Row2 col2 lone_wolf: proud silver-grey wolf head in profile framed by a subtle crescent of violet light, lone silhouette, no moon disc or background.
Row2 col3 expedition_riposte: short katana pointing sharply right with a curved gold return arrow behind it, clean sword silhouette.
Row3 col1 basic tier ring: simple complete bronze circular rim with ONE small inset gemstone at bottom, wide completely transparent empty center for a skill icon.
Row3 col2 intermediate tier ring: refined complete silver circular rim with TWO small inset gemstones at bottom, same outer diameter and transparent empty center as previous.
Row3 col3 advanced tier ring: complete gold circular rim with THREE small violet inset gemstones at bottom, restrained purple glow on exterior, same diameter and transparent empty center.
For the bottom rings: face-on perfect circles, NO icon inside, center must stay completely transparent, ring thickness 8% of diameter, no ticks/numerals. Make three tiers distinguishable by material and gem count without color alone. No skulls, gore or realistic wounds.
